governing_lesson: persistent residual != substrate limit, until the interface family has actually flattened on the current rung's current task

jev_v0_4_gate_a_scope.ESTABLISHES: on that semantic-stress program, with that target family, readout family and evaluation contract, the best reasonable frozen interfaces had not been shown to flatten; adaptation was unauthorized THERE
DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: that any substrate had reached a substrate limit
that any System 1.5 model-level intervention is unauthorized
anything about the causal Lexi lane, the Lepori lane, or any other task or readout family
jev_v0_4_gate_a_scope.carried_forward_as: a METHOD (the A-F ledger and its named controls), not a VERDICT about substrates
jev_v0_4_gate_a_scope.anti_pattern: a good gate must not become a universal traffic cop

lane_specificity_corrections.note: unchanged and correct on that scope

open_provenance_items.item: causal-Lexi MOVE figure, stated in program memory as roughly 0.48-0.49
open_provenance_items.rule: pin from the causal-Lexi run receipt before it enters any matrix cell
open_provenance_items.hard_rule: do not record an unverified number in a matrix

open_provenance_items.item: IHA has no definition in this program
open_provenance_items.evidence: 8 mentions, all qualified as 'IHA-style cross-head mixing remains unearned'; never expanded, never built, twice deferred
open_provenance_items.consequence: any matrix cell or rung depending on IHA is unspecifiable until a separate frozen artifact defines it

axes_are: structural, per-cell, never free text; measurement predicates are NOT frozen here

two_axes_kept_separate.within_family_scale: M varies, architecture and training recipe held fixed
two_axes_kept_separate.between_family: architecture and training history vary, M roughly matched

scale_and_family.void_if: a between-family comparison that has silently also varied scale

third_confound.name: recipe_maturity
third_confound.why: a family with a long experimental trail has had more attempts at target ontology, surfaces, candidate representation, loss, curriculum and adapters; the confound must be visible rather than absorbed into 'architecture'

ladder_reality.rule: do not write matrix cells for rungs that have no pinned substrate

response_vector.rule_text: no composite capability score is permitted

coordinates.direction: is the capability signalled in the right direction at all
coordinates.gain: how much probability or margin moved
coordinates.boundary_crossing: did it cross from inaccessible to reliable, or merely move
coordinates.locality: is the effect where it should be, against sham controls
coordinates.preservation: did prior capabilities survive the change

interpretive_rules: direction without boundary_crossing is not competence
gain without locality is not the effect you think it is
response_vector.boundary_crossing_requires: a preregistered reliability floor per capability, which is NOT frozen here because it depends on admitted targets

1_accessibility.question: can the distinction be recovered at all

4_operationalization.question: can the state improve the final action
4_operationalization.why_a_distinct_stage: the program has replicated evidence that a good semantic state does not produce a good action

5_robustness.question: does it survive renderer, candidate reorder, schema, world-family, sibling and counterfactual shift

data_axis.why: 100k examples concentrated on one easy pattern is not equivalent to 100k examples spanning support, conflict, missingness, composition, transition and nuisance invariance
data_axis.plotting_rule: acquisition curves are plotted against COVERAGE, with N as a secondary label
data_axis.current_honest_state: O1 yielded ZERO permission-cleared human roots, so acquisition curves are SYNTHETIC-ONLY until source permissions resolve; a synthetic-only curve is a real measurement but is not evidence about human-grounded data and must not be described as such

interface_budget.why: so that 'reasonable' cannot be defined retroactively by whatever happened to be tried

ladder.name: task-specific recurrence, if earned on this rung

interface_budget.claim_allowed_only_after: I1-I6 are exhausted on the current rung's current task
interface_budget.claim_permitted_then: this residual survived reasonable access machinery
interface_budget.inherits_from: jev v0.4 gate A, generalized: the fix is a declared budget plus a named saturation predicate, not a stronger claim

conditions.1_interface_flattening: the rung's declared interface set has flattened, via a named terminal transition plus declared controls (the rung-local analogue of Jev gate A)
conditions.2_data_diminishing_returns: more capability-targeted data, measured on the coverage vector not the raw count, gives diminishing gains
conditions.3_replicated_residual_identity: the same residual failure families persist across at least a few materially different interventions, quantified by family-level Jaccard overlap

graduation.scope: on the rung's own task, within its declared interface budget
graduation.handoff_artifact: the residual set, NOT the old benchmark
graduation.anti_premature_graduation: a rung that skipped an interface because it obviously would not help has NOT flattened; undeclared skipped interfaces are recorded as undeclared and condition 1 fails

residual_family_identity.why: WHICH families persist is what distinguishes a data wall from an architecture wall from a composition wall

interpretation_rule.text: No rung failure may be reported as a substrate deficit until a RUNG-LOCAL interface saturation check exists for that rung's task
interpretation_rule.symmetry: protects a rung from being understated and from being overstated

ordering: capability matrix populated with valid cells only
constructive interventions I5, I6, I7 in order
graduation upward carrying the residual set
program_state.minicpm_may_continue: causal Phase 0/1 System 1.5 interface; not invalidated by Jev v0.4 gate A, which is scoped to a different program; inherits the interpretation rule
program_state.micro_lora: none yet - not by fiat, but because no rung has exhausted a declared interface budget on any task
